scientific_integrity: An analytic cubic Schur–Jury proof supports all universal claims. Symbolic and finite cases provide reproducibility but not proof. Novelty is a best-knowledge assessment with residual prior-art risk.
scientific_limitations: Equal diagonal curvatures, two coordinates, one cyclic query per update, full buffer, fixed learning rate and memory decay, deterministic quadratic, exact arithmetic; no claim for arbitrary objectives or dimensions.
title: A sharp coupling-dependent stability frontier for fading-memory cyclic coordinate gradients
